analysis.summary: A binary tree has at most two children per node. Inorder traversal visits the left subtree, root, then right subtree.

topics.name: Binary tree traversal
concepts: Inorder: left, root, right. For a binary search tree, this produces sorted keys.
definitions: Leaf: a node with no children.

quiz.question: Which traversal yields sorted keys in a binary search tree?
quiz.explanation: Left keys are smaller than the root; right keys are larger.

flashcards.front: How many children can a binary tree node have?
